description: This Java class `ImmutableDittoHeaders` is an immutable implementation of the `DittoHeaders` interface, providing a way to handle header key-value pairs within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a factory method for creating instances and overrides methods to provide specific behavior related to header definitions.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoHeaders
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the DittoHeaders interface, encapsulating a map of headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ImmutableDittoHeaders from a map of headers.

methods.name: getSpecificDefinitionByKey
methods.description: Overrides the method to return an empty Optional, indicating no specific header definitions for this class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to include the class name and header details.
